equivalence_note: Weekly A1 balance sheet + DAILY ES balances (A3): the AUD has a daily reserves series, closer to the Fed's H.4.1/daily data than CAD or GBP.

es_surplus_daily.label: Surplus ES balances (adjusted for late payments / minimum requirements)

sf_repos_surplus_rate.label: Open repo (standing facility at the ES rate) — operational, used for payments, NOT stress
sf_repos_surplus_rate.equivalence_note: operational; usage < $5bn (Aug 2026); facility ceases early 2027 → parser must tolerate the column disappearing

sf_repos_margin.label: Overnight standing-facility repos at target + 25 bp (penalty)
sf_repos_margin.equivalence_note: emergency gauge (Primary credit analogue): > 0 = flag, sustained = panic

omo_reverse_repos.label: Outstanding OMO reverse repos (liquidity provided by the RBA)
omo_reverse_repos.equivalence_note: demand-driven full-allotment repos — quantity is not a policy signal

omo_repos_absorb.label: Outstanding OMO repos (liquidity absorbed)
omo_repos_absorb.equivalence_note: column empty in A3 = no usage (0)

government_account.label: Australian Government deposits at the RBA

aud_investments.label: Australian dollar investments (AGS/semis held outright + repo)

omo_takeup_weekly.label: OMO weekly take-up: amount allotted (7d + 28d), by operation
omo_takeup_weekly.equivalence_note: THE demand-driven signal: rising take-up = banks replacing declining reserves; surge > p90 = early friction before AONIA moves (RBA's own scarcity indicator #2)

apf_holdings_a31.label: RBA holdings of AGS and semis (run-off of the bond portfolio)

securities_lending.label: RBA securities lending (own + on behalf of AOFM)

fx_transactions.label: RBA net FX transactions / official reserve assets (A4 monthly; A5 daily intervention, rare)
fx_transactions.equivalence_note: binary flag FX_OPERATION; not a regular liquidity tool today

net_liquidity.label: Balance-sheet liquidity = Total assets − Australian Government deposits
net_liquidity.equivalence_note: kept as the cross-currency balance-sheet analogue; NOT the primary AUD reserves gauge (that is ES total vs the RBA demand estimate + price). State-government deposits exist in A1 but are immaterial (< $50m).

es_balances_dod.label: ES balances Δ day/day (daily reserve impulse)

omo_outstanding.label: OMO reverse repos outstanding (bilateral + triparty) — reserves supplied on demand
omo_outstanding.equivalence_note: RBA Aug-2026: $20–30bn; quantity is demand, not a policy signal

omo_share_of_es.label: OMO-supplied share of ES
omo_share_of_es.equivalence_note: repo-supplied share of ES; RBA Aug-2026: OMO $20–30bn outstanding vs ES ~$200bn. Escalates only with price confirmation

omo_takeup_weekly.label: OMO weekly take-up (allotted)
omo_takeup_weekly.equivalence_note: Phase 2b parser of a3-omo-repo-transaction-details; OMO_TAKEUP_SURGE flag

currency_drain.label: Currency drain (−Δ notes on issue, autonomous)
currency_drain.equivalence_note: Outside money: not subtracted from balance-sheet liquidity (cross-currency rule)

es_vs_demand_ceiling.label: ES total − RBA demand estimate ceiling (100 bn)
es_vs_demand_ceiling.equivalence_note: distance to the top of the RBA's $70–100bn demand estimate (Jacobs 2026-08-25)

balance_sheet_phase.label: Balance-sheet phase
balance_sheet_phase.note: passive run-off of the bond portfolio; reserves replaced on demand via weekly full-allotment OMO (target + 10 bp)

omo_stock_daily.label: OMO reverse repos outstanding — from operations (principal)

omo_wa_spread_bp.label: OMO weighted-average spread to the cash rate target (bp; full allotment at +10 since 2025-04-09)
omo_wa_spread_bp.equivalence_note: A3: a spread above the fixed +10 bp would mean the fixed-price full-allotment framework changed

omo_unwinds_next_4w.label: OMO unwinds next 4 weeks (RBA published schedule; principal + interest)
omo_unwinds_next_4w.note: A4: scheduled drain; rolled weekly on Wednesdays

unwinds_vs_implied_pct.label: Reconciliation: published unwind − (dealt + term) implied maturity, % (≈ accrued interest)
unwinds_vs_implied_pct.equivalence_note: quality control: same-day settlement convention verified when this stays ≈ 0.3 %

omo_stock_vs_a3_error.label: Reconciliation: OMO stock from operations − A3 outstanding (AORROMO, interest included)

omo_data_cut.label: Last OMO operation in the file
